title: Why Off-Plan Buyers Will Never Download 212 GB to See a Condo
seoTitle: Off-Plan vs GTA 6: Why Buyers Will Not Download 212 GB
description: Gamers wait two days for GTA 6. Off-plan buyers give you 30 seconds and one link. Why presale information must be complete and light at the same time.
answer: A gamer will wait hours, even close to two days, for a 212 GB game because he is motivated and will play for hundreds of hours. An off-plan buyer is not sure yet. He gives a developer about 30 seconds and one link. So presale information has to be complete for every unit and still open in a second on any phone.
body:
GTA 6 asked players for a pre-load of up to 212 GB, and some of them waited almost two days to start playing. Nobody complained. Now picture a developer asking a buyer to download 212 GB just to see his future condo. Nobody would do it. That gap between the gamer and the buyer is the whole point of this short.

## Why the gamer waits and the buyer does not

The gamer gives Rockstar a full day and 212 GB because he wants to play. He knows he will spend hundreds of hours in that city, so the wait feels small.

Your buyer is in a different place. He is not sure yet. He gives you about 30 seconds and one link, often on his phone at 10 at night after dinner. If that link is slow, heavy or empty, he closes it and moves on.

## Realism is not the problem in real estate

Real estate already has realism. Many sales galleries run presentations on game engines, with digital twins on large touchscreens. But in my experience those stations need powerful local computers and can cost tens of thousands of dollars each. The realism lives in one room, and the buyer in Toronto, Dubai or Milan is not in that room. What reaches him is usually a PDF.

## What a winning presale link looks like

Video games win with the heaviest download in the world. Off-plan wins with the lightest link that still shows the truth of every unit. In practice that means:

- **Complete:** every unit, every window, every view, nothing missing.
- **Light:** it opens in about a second, with no install and no special hardware.
- **Everywhere:** it works on any phone, in any country, at any hour.

The race is not about the most beautiful image. It is about the most complete one that can travel to the buyer.

This short comes from a full episode where I also cover what GTA 6 costs to make, how sales galleries use game engines and what happened to metaverse land. Listen at [/podcast/off-plan-vs-gta-6-212-gb-to-see-a-condo/](/podcast/off-plan-vs-gta-6-212-gb-to-see-a-condo/).
takeaways: Gamers accept a 212 GB download because they are motivated and will play for hundreds of hours.
An off-plan buyer is unsure and gives a developer about 30 seconds and one link.
Real estate already has realism, but it is locked inside the sales gallery.
A winning presale link is complete for every unit and opens in a second on any phone.
faq: How long does an off-plan buyer spend on a project link?
In my experience, an unsure buyer gives a project about 30 seconds and one link before deciding whether to keep looking.
Why not use game engine visuals online for presales?
High-end game engine presentations are heavy. They usually need powerful local hardware, so they stay in the sales gallery instead of reaching buyers on their phones.
What should a presale website show buyers?
It should show complete information for every unit, including its windows and views, and it should open quickly on any phone without downloads.
